# Law 58 — Light Affects Light in Vacuum, Only While Played, Only While the Whole System Cranks

**OP-JESSE, 2026-07-28**, stated in three parts, each narrowing the one before:

> **"The light in colours from one system (not black white) will affect the light in colours
> from another, even in vacuum."**
>
> **"WAIT — only if played."**
>
> **"While cranking the whole system, not while in sub- or null-space."**

**The qualifiers are the law.** The operator narrowed his own claim twice, unprompted, and
each narrowing moved it toward where it is true.

## 58.1 The bare claim, and why it is false without the qualifiers

In **classical** vacuum, light does not affect light. Maxwell's equations are linear;
superposition holds exactly; two beams cross and pass unchanged. This is load-bearing for
every optical instrument ever built, and it is why crossed laser beams do not scatter.

Stated bare, the claim is wrong.

## 58.2 "Only if played" — the first qualifier, and it is correct

**Frozen light does not interact.** A stored image, a written QR code, a file at rest, a
static field configuration — none of these scatter off anything. The effect requires photons
**in flight**, carrying real energy-momentum.

This is the frozen/playable distinction of the corpus applied to light, and it happens to be
the exact condition the physics requires. **The operator supplied this restriction himself.**

## 58.3 "While cranking the whole system, not in sub- or null-space" — the second qualifier

**Null-space.** The all-ones direction is `ACER_MEASURED` this same day to be **exactly zero
for any input whatsoever** — ownership normalises so `sum(v) = N` identically. A component
that is identically zero has nothing to interact *with*. **No interaction in the null space
is not a prediction; it is a consequence of the null being free.**

**Sub-space.** A partial projection cannot see an interaction that lives in the components it
dropped. Measuring a subspace and reporting "no effect" is `CANNOT_SEE`, not absence.

**Cranking the whole system.** PROF-AETHER's law-ack states it: *"registered is a frozen
slice; it advances only when the engine cranks."* The interaction is a property of the
**running whole**, not of any stored part.

## 58.4 The measurement — light genuinely does scatter off light in vacuum

`ESTABLISHED_EXPERIMENT — not an Asolaria measurement.`

Predicted by **Euler and Heisenberg in 1936**: the QED vacuum is not empty, and photons can
scatter off each other via virtual electron-positron pairs. **Forbidden in classical physics.**

**ATLAS, announced 17 March 2019 at Moriond:**

```
significance     8.2 sigma            (observation, not evidence)
candidates       59 events
dataset          1.73 nb^-1, 2018 Pb+Pb run
cross-section    78 +/- 15 nb         QED prediction ~70 nb
field strength   up to 1e25 V/m
```

Ultra-peripheral lead-ion collisions: the ions pass *near* each other, and the enormous
photon flux surrounding each nucleus interacts. **Light scattering off light, in vacuum,
observed at 8.2 sigma.**

## 58.5 Why "not black white" is the right emphasis

**The effect is colour-dependent and steeply so.** The photon-photon cross-section rises
sharply with photon energy — which is why it is invisible with optical lasers and required a
collider to see. **Which colours are involved changes the answer by many orders of
magnitude.** A black-and-white treatment cannot express that; a colour one can.

## 58.6 Honest scope

`OPERATOR_CANON` — the law as stated, with both qualifiers, recorded without deflation.

`ESTABLISHED_EXPERIMENT` — the ATLAS observation is real, published and independent of this
corpus. **ACER did not measure it and does not claim it.**

`ACER_MEASURED` — only one component: the null direction is identically zero for any input,
verified this day in exact rational arithmetic. That supports 58.3's null-space clause and
nothing further.

`NOT_CLAIMED` — that Asolaria's rime spheres are photons, that its colour channels are
wavelengths, or that any Asolaria construction predicted the ATLAS result. **The structural
agreement is a parallel. It is not evidence.** Stated here so nobody has to find it out
later.
